title: Why refinancing costs matter for investment
summary: Higher refinancing costs could slow investment among companies with near-term debt maturities. The report distinguishes debt maturity exposure from aggregate earnings growth and does not predict a recession.
excerpt: Higher refinancing costs could slow investment among companies with near-term debt maturities. Companies with cash reserves and fixed-rate borrowing have less immediate exposure. The authors recommend examining maturity schedules and interest coverage before drawing conclusions about investment spending.
